visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a rapid sequence of digital game character avatars (Orc, Elf, Dwarf, Human) appearing over a dark background. A cartoon avatar of a young man with black hair and a red shirt is positioned in the top left corner throughout the video. (2) A height-chart graphic appears showing a lineup of diverse fantasy creatures from 'World of Warcraft', including a Panda, Werewolf, and Troll. The camera zooms in on a small green Goblin character at the bottom of the lineup. (3) Gameplay footage from an RPG environment shows a small green Goblin standing before a much taller blonde human character in red and blue clothing. They are in a desert town setting with bright, direct simulated sunlight and wooden structures. (4) Transition to a close-up of a blonde male Elf character in black armor who is speaking aggressively and pointing at the viewer. Yellow variety captions with black outlines appear over him. (5) A wooden sign with black text reading 'Proteus Effect' appears on a dark background. Below it, the cartoon avatar returns, holding a paper document. (6) A series of text slides appear sequentially with arrows indicating psychological correlations. These slides have a clean dark background with white and yellow text. (7) Footage from a 'Spider-Man' video game shows the character swinging through a highly detailed urban city with realistic skyscrapers and moving cars under clear daylight. (8) A technical diagram appears labeled with letters (a) through (f) showing a male 3D model in various stages of muscular development, from lean to extremely muscular, overlaid with color-coded text boxes. (9) The video concludes with a green checkmark icon appearing over the most muscular character model.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 遊戲角色會改變性格?! [Logo]: 維維維. [Subtitle]: 你知道嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 用什麼角色影響現實! 會影響你現實的行動! (3) [Subtitle]: 一批大學生隨機讓他們用「高個子」或「矮個子」的角色. (4) [Subtitle]: 接著——跟別人談怎麼分錢. (5) [Subtitle]: 高個角色的玩家比較強勢, 開價硬、講話有自信. (6) [Subtitle]: 贏面也比較大! [Variety]: 啊, 我7你3. (7) [Subtitle]: 反觀矮角色的玩家... 比較委婉, 連氣勢都輸一截. [Variety]: ......OK. (8) [Subtitle]: 學者最後發現, 長期用某種形象後. (9) [Subtitle]: 人們在現實的行為也可能受到影響. (10) [Subtitle]: 比如更加自信或更加膽怯. (11) [Slogan]: 普羅透斯效應. [Subtitle]: 這就是超酷的心理學現象——「普羅透斯效應」! (12) [Subtitle]: 還有這些神奇影響. (13) [Slogan]: 用帥哥美女角色 -> 現實中會變得更自信. (14) [Slogan]: 看到自己的角色運動 -> 會更想去運動. (15) [Slogan]: 角色是外國人 -> 外文會變好. (16) [Slogan]: 扮演愛因斯坦 -> 數學解題變強. (17) [Subtitle]: 用超級英雄, 現實中更愛幫助別人. (18) [Subtitle]: 最猛的是, 有個研究讓病患換上不同虛擬角色. (19) [Subtitle]: 發現——痛感會減輕! (20) [Subtitle]: 而男生如果用的是肌肉猛男角色, 止痛效果更是直接加倍!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-paced electronic pop background music featuring a strong 4/4 beat. A male narrator introduces the topic with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the initial text. (2) As the narrator describes the psychological study, the background music continues steadily. Each transition is accompanied by a subtle 'whoosh' or 'pop' sound effect to emphasize visual shifts. (3) The vocal delivery becomes more rhythmic as a list of effects is read. Each item on the list is punctuated by a short digital chime or UI click. (4) A musical stinger with a slightly different melodic contour plays during the reveal of the 'Proteus Effect' title. (5) The narrator's pitch rises during the final section about muscular avatars and pain reduction, indicating higher emotional valence and excitement. The track concludes with a final synthesized ding.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conceptual Introduction -> Experimental Evidence -> Broad Applications -> Special Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience about the 'Proteus Effect', a psychological phenomenon where digital avatars influence a person's real-world behavior and perception.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density editing and familiar gaming imagery to translate complex psychological concepts into easily digestible social media content.
